parsed.post: New best! Increased DEPTH to 8, improving val_bpb from 1.0622 to 1.0453. The increased capacity is helping even with the fixed 5-minute budget. Next, I'll investigate if increasing ASPECT_RATIO improves performance or if it hits diminishing returns/computational bottlenecks.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if a larger context/window improves performance, building on the successful DEPTH increase.
